hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the latent object F(theta, z) = polygamma(theta, z) at theta = 0 to obtain polygamma(0, z) and at theta = 1 to obtain polygamma(1, z). The derivative relation d/dz F(theta, z) = F(theta+1, z) is treated as a required structural link between consecutive specializations.
required_assumptions: polygamma(theta, z) is defined for theta = 0 and theta = 1.
Differentiation with respect to z commutes with specialization of theta.
hypotheses.rationale: The two members are consecutive orders of the polygamma function, and the reported derivative relation diff(polygamma(0, z), z) == polygamma(1, z) indicates a one-parameter derivative family rather than unrelated substitutions.
